rollups.text: James’s dogs and related milestones: Max and Daisy were identified as James’s two dogs on 2022-03-17; by 2022-05-04 he had three dogs, Max, Ned, and Daisy. James adopted puppy Ned from a Stamford shelter during 2022-04-05..2022-04-11. Daisy is a Labrador; Max and Ned are shepherds. James said the dogs are like family and bring him joy; Daisy loves toys and eating. Max enjoys swimming and catching frisbees, and James takes him on walks. The dogs know sit, stay, paw, and rollover, and James taught them to balance on a skateboard. James began introducing the three dogs on 2022-06-17, and they were gradually adapting and bonding. On 2022-08-05 James took an unspecified puppy for a routine exam and vaccination.

James’s recurring gaming interests and experiences: he praised The Witcher 3’s story, atmosphere, world, choices, and graphics (2022-03-17, 2022-08-10, 2022-10-13); his first Nintendo introduced him to Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda as a child. In 2022 he played Apex Legends with his team, explored RPGs and strategy games, and drew inspiration from Civilization and Total War. He tried Cyberpunk 2077 on 2022-10-20 and found it great and addictive. He considered or tried other genres, including strategy games, RPGs, MOBAs, and sports games; on 2022-11-05 he planned to practice FIFA 23 before playing with John. He joined a new gaming platform in March, bought a gaming system, and later got a video card for new games. James enjoys gaming for relaxation, connection, and challenge.

James’s travel and outings: he visited Italy in 2021 and had also visited Turkey and Mexico by 2022-04-20 (the latter two dates are unspecified). He planned a trip departing for Toronto on the evening of 2022-07-11, with Vancouver among intended stops, and later said he had visited Nuuk and returned with many impressions; he brought souvenirs for John and Jill. On 2022-11-04 he began a road trip with family and dogs, visiting friends Josh and Mark and an animal sanctuary during the trip. He also took the dogs hiking in wooded trails on 2022-04-21.

James’s leisure activities beyond gaming: he loves bowling and got two strikes on 2022-03-16; he went surfing on 2022-07-06 and rope-jumped from as high as 150 meters on 2022-07-08. He enjoys nature walks and hiking, reading, and board games with friends. As a child he skateboarded with John and friends, and he still sometimes rides a skateboard. He started learning an instrument in March 2022 and practiced daily; he had played guitar when younger and liked rock music.

James’s food preferences: he especially loves pepperoni pizza and also likes cheese and prosciutto pizza. In 2022 he began cooking classes despite previously not liking cooking; his first lesson included an omelette, meringue, simple dishes, and learning to make dough. Classes cost $10 each.

James’s game-development progression: on 2022-03-17 he described programming as central to his life, with experience in Python and C++, website building, and game mods; he was developing a childhood-inspired computer game. In April he collaborated with a gaming friend on a Witcher 3-inspired virtual world, and separately finished a months-long project after learning a new language. On 2022-04-29 a serious bug in a game project he had worked on for weeks was fixed with friends’ help. By 2022-08-26 he hoped to make a Civilization-inspired strategy game; on 2022-09-01 he reported finishing a strategy game in Unity after considerable effort and trial-and-error balancing. By 2022-10-13 he had released his first game to the gaming community and wanted to make more. The reported milestones span about seven months, from 2022-03-17 to 2022-10-13.

James’s competitive gaming: on 2022-04-03 he entered an online tournament, reached the semifinals, won some rounds, and did not advance; he enjoyed it and hoped to compete again. During 2022-07-02..2022-07-08 he won an online gaming tournament, felt fulfilled, and was motivated to improve. These two recorded tournament outcomes occurred about three months apart.

James’s game streaming: by 2022-09-18 he had started streaming but had no results to report yet. On 2022-09-19 he streamed a game and received many positive community comments, which excited and inspired him to continue. This progress was reported over about one day.

James’s relationship with Samantha: on 2022-08-09 he met Samantha at a beach outing, received her phone number, and considered asking her on a date; he planned to call her on 2022-08-11. On 2022-09-03 he asked her to be his girlfriend at a theater, and she agreed. By 2022-10-31 James said they had decided to move in together and had rented an apartment near McGee’s bar. The recorded developments span about 83 days, from meeting to the reported shared apartment decision.

James’s cooking hobby: on 2022-09-02 he signed up for a cooking class to learn something new despite not previously liking cooking; at the first lesson he prepared several dishes, successfully made an omelette, made meringue, and learned how to make dough. By 2022-09-04 he described cooking as a new hobby and hoped to cook something for John after learning more. The change from signing up to calling it a hobby took about two days.
James was recorded entering or winning two online gaming tournaments: he reached the semifinals in one on 2022-04-03, then won one during 2022-07-02..2022-07-08.

James’s recorded dogs increased from two (Max and Daisy) on 2022-03-17 to three (Max, Daisy, and Ned) after he adopted Ned during 2022-04-05..2022-04-11; by 2022-11-07 he said he considered more than three dogs too many.

John’s games and gaming activities: The Witcher 3 was a game he intended to try (2022-03-17) and was later playing and enjoying for its storytelling, characters, and consequential choices (2022-08-10); CS:GO was his favorite game (2022-03-27), which he played in a convention tournament (2022-03-27) and organized tournaments for (2022-05-07, 2022-08-06). He also played an unnamed dystopian RPG (2022-04-12), Assassin’s Creed Valhalla (2022-04-29), an unnamed strategy board game with friends (2022-04-27..2022-04-29), an unnamed card game resembling UNO (2022-04-29), an unnamed impostor-identification game resembling Among Us (2022-04-29), Dungeons of the Dragon (2022-09-11..2022-09-17), Cyberpunk 2077 (by 2022-10-03), and FIFA 23 (2022-11-05). He began playing chess online and at a club (2022-07-22), and later won a regional chess tournament (2022-11-05). He also competed in a local tournament and placed second (2022-05-20).

John’s programming and game-development activities: He signed up for a programming class to refresh HTML and CSS (2022-03-17); worked through a difficult algorithm assignment (2022-04-23); took freelance work building a local business’s website, including figuring out payments (2022-04-29); volunteered to build an inventory-and-donations app for a children’s charity (2022-05-11); started a coding blog (week of 2022-06-06..2022-06-12); joined an online programming group and collaborated on a project (2022-08-19..2022-08-21); taught his younger siblings coding and worked with them on a text adventure (2022-08-26..2022-09-01), and taught his parents coding (by 2022-09-04). He made a 2D puzzle-and-exploration mobile game over several months and planned an October launch (2022-09-20), organized an online competition with programmer friends (week of 2022-10-06..2022-10-12) and a programming seminar (week of 2022-10-10..2022-10-16), and worked with a game developer on an online board game, planning a demo (2022-11-05..2022-11-07).

John’s charitable and community activities: He organized a CS:GO tournament with friends and donated proceeds to a nearby dog shelter, using remaining funds to buy and cook food for homeless people (2022-05-07); volunteered to develop software for a children’s charitable foundation (2022-05-11); considered volunteering and nonprofit work to make a positive impact (2022-06-19); and held a gaming tournament for a children’s hospital, featuring Fortnite, Overwatch, and Apex Legends (2022-10-30). He said he wanted to keep organizing events combining gaming, friendly competition, and community benefit (2022-05-08).

John’s reading interests and recommendations: He enjoys science fiction and fantasy, especially epic fantasy with immersive world-building and intricate plots; favorite series include The Stormlight Archive and Kingkiller Chronicle, and he recommends The Expanse (2022-06-16). He recommended The Name of the Wind to James (2022-04-29). He also reads to relax and escape into imaginative worlds (2022-07-09).

John’s other hobbies and interests: He took up metal detecting and searched beaches, finding mostly bottle caps, coins a couple of times, and a gold ring once (2022-03-20); started playing drums and had played for a month (2022-03-27), though later said he had not played in a while and liked electronic and rock music (2022-09-18); and started a portable-smoker startup, welding his first smoker (2022-09-19). He likes pizza, especially Hawaiian pizza with pineapple and ham, and had not tried prosciutto pizza as of 2022-05-04. He dislikes dark beer and prefers a light beer (by 2022-08-27).

John’s career direction shifted toward purpose-driven work and gaming. On 2022-06-13 he said he had received an offer for his dream job after many interviews and late nights, with a July start planned. By 2022-08-06 he had left an IT job where he had worked for three years and begun a new job aligned with his values; he was happy with the decision. That day he described a goal of becoming a gaming-tournament organizer in his state, including CS:GO and Fortnite events, and planned to build experience and use helpful connections. On 2022-08-21 he remained keen to host eSports competitions. On 2022-10-03 he was excited about a volunteer programming-mentor opportunity at a game-development nonprofit, seeing it as a possible path toward combining gaming and helping people.

John’s first mobile game: By 2022-09-20 he had spent several months building a 2D adventure game with puzzles and exploration, using a game-design book, tutorials, and developer forums; he was proud of it and planned to launch it in October. He kept the project secret until then because he feared disappointment if it did not work out. James offered to test it, and John said he would let him know when testing was ready. Latest recorded state: launch was planned, but no launch outcome is given.

John’s chess development: He started playing chess in July 2022, mostly online, and joined a chess club to practice with others; he hoped it would improve strategy and decision-making. James recommended studying openings and analyzing games (2022-07-22). By 2022-11-05 John had won a regional chess tournament after practice, felt proud and gained confidence, and advised James to study openings, learn from experienced players, and review past games. Elapsed time from starting chess to the recorded tournament win: about 106 days.

John’s coding instruction with family: On 2022-08-26 he was helping younger siblings who had joined a programming course and building a simple text-based adventure game with them. By 2022-09-01 they were making basic games and stories, learning quickly, and enjoying coding; John found teaching them fulfilling. By 2022-09-04 his parents had also recently begun learning coding from him, and he said teaching them brought the family closer.

John was recorded organizing or co-organizing at least three gaming-related events: a CS:GO charity tournament benefiting a dog shelter and homeless people (2022-05-07), an online competition with programmer friends (week of 2022-10-06..2022-10-12), and a charity tournament for a children’s hospital featuring Fortnite, Overwatch, and Apex Legends (2022-10-30). These are distinct recorded events; his broader stated intention was to organize more.

John’s competitive gaming achievements recorded at least twice: he placed second in a local tournament and received prize money (2022-05-20), then won a regional chess tournament (2022-11-05). The events were in different competitions; the chess victory followed his reported start in chess on 2022-07-22, about 106 days earlier.
